enrichment.why: Solomon is a cooldown-driven zone controller: persistent bishop zones (slow + spirit ticks + diagonal mines, T3 stacks a -2.5/stack armor shred) and a two-rook immobilize convert telegraphed hub fights better than raw DPS. Kingside Knight (ally stamina + barrier, double barrier self-cast, T3 cleanse) plus an invulnerable reposition on the piece makes him a genuine enabler under the 38s respawn tax. He is not a top camp-clearer, so his income rides on heavy-melee crate routes and team souls rather than solo jungle farming.

builds.name: Cooldown control
builds.notes: Spams bishop/rook on short cooldowns; the winning cluster (Mystic Burst 71% early, Arcane Surge 80% mid).

builds.name: Barrier support
builds.notes: Leans into Kingside Knight barrier + cleanse for teamfights; Divine Barrier sits at 62% late WR.

builds.name: Gun
builds.notes: Swift Striker is a trap here (20% mid, 33% late WR) — no kit reason to buy attack speed yet.

enrichment.matchup_notes: Bishop tiles plus rook immobilize punish anything that must physically occupy hub space, so melee divers and low-mobility poke (Grey Talon, Seven) get zoned. He in turn dies to burst mobility that lands before he can self-cast Knight's invuln (Lash, Holliday, Calico) and to Vindicta's range. He is a strong pick-enabler: immobilize + shred set up Lash, Holliday and Paradox dives.
enabled_by: Hub-fight meta (Sunken Plaza ~5-8 min, Bell Tower 8+) rewarding telegraphed zone control
Superior Cooldown / Arcane Surge cooldown stacking
Heavy melee 116 opening Tough Crates for guaranteed 58-soul routes
Barrier + cleanse support value under the 38s respawn tax
countered_by: Silence (Silencer, Silence Wave) denying the cooldown loop
Burst mobility landing before the self-cast invuln
enrichment.notes: Develop Queen tooltip is empty — ult power is the single biggest unknown; T2 hints a 'Checkmate' threshold (200/5) scaled by slow. Gun builds are losing, spirit/cooldown builds winning, but on small novelty samples. If 7-day data shows the Knight/Divine Barrier build clustering >55% WR, promote to A; if zone impact proves marginal in the fast-cast meta, drop toward C.

card.headline: Bishop-zone strategist who wins hub fights with slows, immobilize and ally barriers — but folds to burst and silence.
kit_read: Setup Bishop: persistent zone of slow + spirit ticks with diagonal mine tiles; T3 stacks up to 10 shred stacks (-2.5 each) to amp team damage.
Kingside Knight: ally stamina + barrier (double barrier self-cast), invulnerable reposition on Move; T3 adds a rare cleanse.
Rook Battery: two immobilizing rooks that reflect off walls; T2 tags 5% current-HP, T3 extends immobilize. Corridor/objective denial and pick setup.
Develop Queen: ultimate tooltip empty; T2 implies a slow-scaled 'Checkmate' threshold — value unclear, treat as the swing factor.
card.meta_fit: A forced-group-fight and chokepoint hero in a map that concentrates fights at Sunken Plaza and Bell Tower, so his zones and immobilize land where it counts. He doesn't clear camps like the top archetype, so he banks on crate routes and team income rather than solo farming.
threatens: Drifter — must walk into tiles/immobilize to commit, gets shredded and slowed
Abrams — slow + mine zones blunt his space-taking dive
Grey Talon — out-zoned and out-sustained at range
Seven — static poke walks into bishop denial
threatened_by: Lash — burst dive lands before the self-cast invuln
Holliday — mobile burst closes outside the zone
Vindicta — long range kills him from outside bishop coverage
Silencer / Silence Wave — denies the cooldown loop he's built around
Supressor/Unstoppable — item answers that ignore immobilize or slow
card.build_read: Spirit/cooldown is correct: Extra Spirit, Mystic Burst, Superior Cooldown, Arcane Surge, Boundless Spirit, with Divine Barrier as the support pivot. Gun builds (Swift Striker) underperform badly and have no kit reason to exist.
what_to_watch: Develop Queen's real effect (empty tooltip) — it decides whether he is A or C
Whether the barrier/cleanse support build or the cooldown control build wins more at the 7-day check
His WR vs burst assassins and silence picks — confirms or breaks the 'folds to burst' read
